balls.text: thigh-high full toss outside off. Dube is late on this too and scuffs it towards deep cover. CSK have fluffed their finishing act, by the looks of it, and they end up on 192!
full toss outside off. Overton is rushed on the full toss and slices it towards deep cover
right in the blockhole, in and around off. Dube clinks it down the ground to long off

Dube running in the quicksand for a moment, but he still gets away. Gets an extra run too! Slower bumper outside off. Dube drags it to square leg. Overton is next to him by the time Dube sets off for the single. Not the swiftest sprint either and Tyagi, after gathering the throw, misses the stumps with his under-arm attempt. Ends up conceding an overthrow instead...
another brilliant yorker on off. Not much Dube can do with it apart from digging it out to long on's left. Back for a brace
almost the perfect wide yorker. Overton still cannot get under it and powers it out towards sweeper cover
very full outside off. Overton cannot get under this enough and cloths it towards long off
full toss wide outside off. Dube throws his hands at it and drills it towards long off
very full and beyond the tramlines on the off side. Dube shoulders arms and the umpire indulges in some more exercise
on a length but far too much outside off. Left alone and called a wide
top yorker outside off. Dube cannot get under it and clinks it back to the bowler
nicely done! Slower ball banged in short outside off. Dube knows square leg is up and lifts it cleverly over that fielder in the ring!
short and wide outside off. Almost on the adjacent strip and don't think KKR will be reviewing this
into the stumps at the other end! Full outside off. Dube winds up and and looks to go downtown. Drills it straight back but too straight in the end

full and wide outside off. Dube lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide. Arora not best pleased with the decision and KKR take it upstairs now. This could be touch-and-go as well. A sliver of the ball is inside the tramlines, and the decision has been overturned!
slower ball on a length wide outside off. Overton has a wild swipe across the line and is too early into it. Swish and a miss
Overton is up and running! Off-pace again but this sits up outside off. Overton lets the ball arrive before thumping it over extra cover!
nails the wide yorker - both in length and line. Overton is late to jam his bat down and the ball squirms past the toe-end of his blade

sliced tamely to short third, and another CSK batter fails to make his start count! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Brevis swishes at it with all his might but the lack of pace means the ball spirals off the top edge. Arora dives smartly to his left and Brevis has to walk back for a 29-ball 41!
another wide full toss but this is beyond the tramlines. Left alone and called a wide
full toss outside off but Brevis cannot make it count. Scuffs it straight to extra cover
length outside off. Dube's feet are stuck to concrete and he pushes it towards mid off
back of a length just outside leg. Brevis, backing away, is tucked up slightly and jabs it towards extra cover, who had moved straighter after the boundary
scorched across the turf! Dropped short outside off. Brevis gives himself ample room and pummels it past extra cover!
oh! Fizzed through on a length on middle. Spins away and Brevis has no clue about it. Reaches out for it in front and gets struck on the back thigh. Too high for an lbw, though
back of a length on middle and off. Dube waits for it before stabbing it towards long on
back of a length and sliding into the pads. Dube helps it fine past the keeper and gets back for two. Given as leg byes, though

off stump knocked back, and Narine gets rid of Sarfaraz! Back of a length, angling into off. Pitches and moves away, though. Sarfaraz has an ungainly swipe across the line and misses the ball by a mile. Off stump rattled, and Sarfaraz's scratchy cameo comes to an end!
full toss and put away! Not the ball Arora was looking for. Was probably targeting the wide yorker. Misses on the fuller side and gets slogged past mid on!

length ball darted across the batter wide outside off. Brevis lets it go, hoping for the wide. Does not get it, and he reviews. Seemed touch-and-go in real-time. No significant movement across by Brevis. And replays suggest the ball is just beyond the tramlines. Decision overturned. Wide called!
length ball speared a mile across off. Would have been a wide had the batter left it. Sarfaraz nearly falls over trying to reach it and scuffs it past the bowler
Sarfaraz goes big too! Marginally short on off. Sarfaraz picks the length early and deposits it over deep backward square leg!
full and wide outside off. Brevis throws himself at it and clinks it towards long off
swiped into the stands! Bashed in short outside off. Climbs through on Brevis but he swings at it with all his might. Off the top edge and well over the fine leg fence!
just over! Banged in short on off. Sarfaraz ducks his head a little and looks to hook it away. Seems to get a top edge that loops over the keeper
hidden well outside off, on a full length. Sarfaraz throws his hands at it and slices it on the bounce to sweeper cover
back of a length delivery wide outside off. Sarfaraz tries to pick the gap behind point but dabs it straight to backward point
thrown up on a length, and very wide outside off. Brevis skips down, reaches out and shanks it towards long off
shortish again but too far outside off. Brevis, having backed away, shoulders arms
fired in on a length, following the batter outside leg. No room to work with for Brevis and he jabs it towards extra cover
Brevis backs away again but this back of a length ball is further beyond the tramlines. Called a wide as Brevis leaves it alone
hung up on a full length wide outside off. Brevis backs away and backs away too much in the end. Cannot reach it and lets it go
slanted in full on middle and leg. Sarfaraz looks for the sweep again and chalks it off the bottom of the bat into the mid wicket region
starts off with a short and wide delivery. Beyond the tramlines and called a wide
back of a length on leg stump. Brevis wants to drop and run into the leg side but drops it too close to the keeper
successive boundaries, and this is a clever stroke! Back of a length just outside off. Brevis waits on it, peels the outer cover off the ball and knifes it between backward point and short third!
short, wide and Brevis gets one away too! Reaches out for it, uses the angle from around the wicket and thrashes it past extra cover!
dragged down outside off. Sarfaraz too early into his hack and toe-ends it towards long on
well, out of sorts no more! Varun gives it air outside off and Sarfaraz gives it even more air. Picks up this slot ball and launches it over wide long on!
angled in full on middle and leg. Sarfaraz brings out the sweep again but cops a blow on the body for his toil
flighted up full outside off. Sarfaraz gets down on one knee and hacks it towards deep mid wicket

lbw shout, not given! Slowed up on a length on middle. Sarfaraz has a swipe across the line and misses it. Gets hit near the rib. Seemed to be straight but the height might have been a problem. No review
back of a length outside off. Sarfaraz hangs back and dabs it straight to short third
back of a length on middle and off. Brevis backs away and chops it into the point region
floated up full on off, and this spins back in. Sarfaraz plays all over it and the ball flicks the pad before rolling past the keeper
away-going ball, on a back of a length outside off. Spins away and Sarfaraz taps it towards extra cover. Wanted the single but his partner was not interested
full outside off. Brevis plants his front foot and scuffs it back past the bowler and mid off. Back for a brace
on a length wide outside off. Sarfaraz looks to go inside-out and shanks it towards log on instead. That was bowled at 145.8kph
back of a length just outside off. Sarfaraz lets the ball hit his bat and angles his blade to dab it towards backward point
wow, some way to get off the mark!143.2kph full ball but laced with width. Sarfaraz jams down on it with an open bat face and glides it past backward point!

straight through Samson, and that is too hot to handle for the World Cup winner! Zipped in full on middle and off. Bowled at 148.1kph and Samson loses his shape. Tries to go too square, and does not come to grips with the pace either. Indulges in a fresh-air shot and hears the rattling of his stumps soon after. Big, big wicket for KKR!
this is a terrific shot! Slower ball bashed in short outside off. Holds in the surface but Samson holds his shot for long enough. Stands tall and slaps it over mid off!
darted in again, on a back of a length on leg. Skids through and Brevis is late on it. Ball rolls off his back leg into the off side
shortish on leg. Samson goes deep into his crease and hacks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on leg. Brevis stays leg side of the ball and jabs it towards sweeper cover
slowed up on a length on leg. Samson has a huge swipe across the line and squirts it off the inside edge into the on side
pushed in again, on a length on off. Samson gets caught on the crease and pokes it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Holds a little in the surface and Samson shanks it back to the bowler
slower ball banged in short outside off. Samson jumps up onto his toes and cuts it towards deep point

too predictable now, and Samson is ready for it! Short and wide again. Sits up a little and Samson uses the pace to carve it over backward point. This was bowled at a little over 140kph. Flew off the bat quicker!
short, wide and this skips through too. At 140.9kph this time and Samson is awfully late on his square cut
short ball does come. Honing into off and bowled at 142.4kph. Brevis rushed on the pull and he cloths it into the on side
back of a length outside off, bowled at 148.4kph. Brevis wafts at it but is again beaten for pace
starts off with a zippy full ball outside off, bowled at 146.1kph. Brevis is late on the drive and only swishes at thin air
given a bit of air, on a fullish length outside off. Brevis has a pop at it but clinks it off the toe-end. On the bounce to long on
back of a length, nipping into off. Samson goes back and knocks it to long off
shortish outside off. Brevis hops back and chops it towards sweeper cover
back of a length on the pads. Samson lets the ball come to him before patting it into the square leg region
pushed in on a length on leg. Samson looks for the sweep and misses. Gets pinged on the body for his troubles

plinked up, but it lands right between four fielders! Brevis could not have placed it better, even if he tried. Full on middle and leg. Holds in the surface and the ball skews off the leading edge. Right between extra cover (running back), mid wicket, long on and long off
fired in on a length on the pads. Brevis helps it round the corner towards deep backward square leg
bat goes one direction, ball goes another! Back of a length on the stumps. Samson throws his bat at it, quite literally, and the bat ends up in the square leg region. Ball bobbles down to long on
flayed away! Back of a length but too wide outside off. Samson frees his arms and slashes it well over backward point!
back of a length on middle and leg. Brevis stabs it to long on
pushed in on a length just outside off. Brevis gets a half stride in and blocks
darted in on a length, following the batter outside leg. Samson tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
Brevis lands his first punch! Tossed up a little but in the slot outside off. Brevis plants his front foot and muscles it over long on!
back of a length outside off. Samson stays back and knocks it to long off
shortish outside off. Brevis hops back and cuts it towards sweeper cover
back of a length on off. Spins away and Samson, hanging back, punches it towards long off
fullish outside off. Moves away and Samson, wafting at it, edges it towards backward point
fullish outside off. Samson gets onto the front foot and defends

this goes a mile up, and taken on the fence! Arora sticks to the short ball and finally it yields dividends. Gets a little too big on off stump, and Mhatre cannot generate the power he wants. Skies it and Ramandeep, stood at deep mid wicket, does the rest. A brisk cameo from Mhatre and he, like Gaikwad, is also livid with himself as he walks off!
banged in again, on middle and off. Mhatre looks to flat-bat this too but ends up shanking it to mid on
sharp bumper on middle and off, and this zips through. Mhatre swipes across the line and feels the ball whistle past his swiping blade
authoritative with a capital A! Dug half-way down outside off. Mhatre rises with the bounce and swats it over the bowler's head!
Mhatre is taking pace down! Misses the yorker outside off on the shorter side. Mhatre gives it all he has and scorches it between mid off and extra cover!
pace back on, and the boundaries return too! Juicy full toss tailing into leg. Mhatre opens up his stance and slugs it over mid wicket!
fired in on a length on middle and leg. Mhatre knocks it to mid on and retains strike
was that a chance?! Back of a length outside off. Seems to hold slightly in the surface. Mhatre has a swish at it and misses. Raghuvanshi fumbles his gather too
into the blockhole on middle and off. Mhatre cannot do much with it and clinks it back to the bowler
back of a length, sliding into the pads. Mhatre does not get bat on it and the ball rolls off the thigh pad towards short fine leg
slower and following the batter outside leg on a length. Samson waits for it and bunts it into the mid wicket region
Samson wants a piece of Anukul now! Floaty slot ball on middle and off. Samson plants his front foot and pumps it over the bowler's head!
going, going, and gone! Slower bumper on off, and Mhatre has read this like the morning daily. He opens up his stance and wallops it over mid wicket!

does not matter to this youngster! You can put ten fielders on the fence, it will still be immaterial if you pop it into the stands. Shortish and sitting up near the hips. Mhatre lifts up his front leg Calypso style and dumps it beyond deep backward square leg!
four more! Oh, to be young, and to be fearless. On a length outside off. Mhatre has chucked the previous ball out of his memory and crashes it through cover point!

jaffa! The perfect Test match ball. On a length in the channel, and this threatens to shape in before curving away. Mhatre, caught on the crease, is beaten all ends up. Not far from the stumps either. Green's extra bounce saving the batter there!
oh, how do you describe that?! Well, let's try. Banged in short outside off, at around 140kph. Mhatre stands tall and forehands it between extra cover and mid off!
fullish outside off and this shapes away too. Samson has a jab at it and guides it with an open bat face towards deep backward point
up and over! Given a bit of air and over-pitched on middle and leg. Mhatre plants his front foot and pops it over mid on. Not the cleanest connection but well clear of mid on!
fuller on leg stump. Samson gets onto the front foot and pushes it to mid on's right
darted in full on off. Samson plays it back to the bowler
slanted in full on the pads. Mhatre works it towards deep mid wicket and opens his account

straight to deep mid wicket, and the experiment has worked wonders! Fired in full just outside off. Gaikwad seems to pre-meditate the sweep and has to then adjust because of how full this is. Quite close to the body too and Gaikwad cannot free his arms fully. Simple chip to the sweeper, and Gaikwad throws his head back in disappointment immediately. Gaikwad's lean run continues, and this is a vital breakthrough for KKR!
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad hangs back and scuffs it into the off side
tries to follow the batter outside leg but this is so far down. Left alone and called a wide
length on middle and off. Gaikwad comes forward and turns it enough to mid wicket's right to keep strike
shortish on middle and leg. Samson looks for the pick-up pull but is rushed on the stroke. Off the thigh pad and behind square for a leg bye
angled in on a length on leg. Samson lets the ball arrive before tucking it towards mid wicket
full just outside off. Gaikwad gets a decent stride in and pushes it towards mid off, where Rahane tumbles to his right and saves three

nicked and past short third! Full outside off, and this moves away late. Gaikwad goes chasing after it and the ball flies off the outside edge past Varun. He leapt to his left but could not get to it!
fullish outside off, with a hint of shape away. Samson drives at it slightly uppishly and the ball bobbles down to deep backward point
and he starts waywardly too. Well down leg and the keeper does well to get a glove to it. Just a couple of extras for CSK
on a length just outside off. Samson presses half forward and defends
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad lets the ball shape into him before running it down to deep backward point
back of a length outside off. Jags back in and Samson, hanging back, jabs it towards deep backward point
edged but this too flies away! Shortish again, although this kicks up, having nipped in from outside off. Samson wafts at it and the ball hurtles off the outside edge over short third!
short, wide and punished again! Sits up nicely and Samson leaps up onto his toes in a flash. Cracks it through point and makes it 8 off 2!
off the mark straightaway! Hooping in-ducker, starting well outside off. A bit too short, though, and Samson rides the bounce to glide it past short third, beating him to his right!

this could be the final ball of the game, but we wait for confirmation because KKR have reviewed. Nothing doing on that count, and CSK make it back-to-back wins at Chepauk, and this is beginning to feel like a fortress all over again! Very full ball outside off. Powell swishes and misses and then, rather cheekily, tries to see if he can get a wide too. Ball well inside the tramlines, though, and that will be that for tonight. CSK with another clinical bowling display and after losing three on the trot, they have now won two on the spin!
full toss on the pads, and Powell gets another six away! Loose ball and Powell makes merry. Shoveled over the long leg fence!
slanted in very full just outside off. Anukul drills it towards mid off

sharp work by Sarfaraz, and Kamboj has another! Low full toss just outside off. Ramandeep shapes for the reverse-lap and gets good purchase on it too. Sarfaraz, though, is alert and springs down to his left at short third to hand Kamboj his second wicket!
low full toss outside off. Ramandeep throws his hands at it and drills it towards extra cover
goes for the leg-stump yorker but strays down leg. Ramandeep misses and the umpire calls it a wide
shot! Consolatory runs these but it is still a high-quality stroke. Opens his bat face to counter this wide yorker and scythes it behind point!

safe! Back of a length on the stumps. Powell hoicks it a mile up and gets it to drop between deep mid wicket and deep square leg. Noor over-runs it, having not accounted for the spin, and Powell gets a brace for his troubles
slower ball on a back of a length but this slides down leg. Powell swings and misses and this time, the wide is called
slower ball on a length wide outside off. Powell swings for the fences and misses. Wide not given, and KKR have reviewed. Replays indicate the ball is well within the tramlines, and on we go!
sharp bumper on middle and off, and this whistles through. Powell swipes at it but gets done in by the extra pace and lift
top yorker outside off. Ramandeep squeezes it out towards backward point
nicely done! Bashed half-way down outside off. Ramandeep rides the bounce and upper-cuts it neatly over short third!
banged in short on off. Ramandeep cannot get a hold of his pull and drags it towards deep square leg
into the blockhole on off. Ramandeep cannot do much with it and digs it out into the off side. A brilliantly-executed over by Kamboj!
zipped in full on leg. Powell snaps his wrists into action but can only whip it straight to deep backward square leg
nails the wide yorker. Ramandeep jams down on it and squeezes it out towards deep backward point
safe! Full and angling across the batter wide outside off. Powell throws his hands at it and slices it on the bounce to deep backward point
on a length on leg. Ramandeep has a huge hoick across the line and chalks it off the toe-end into the on side
very full outside off, bowled from around the wicket. Powell drags it towards the bowler. Kamboj fields it and then fires a throw at the bowler's end. Misses it and gives up an overthrow
starts off with a wide, and Samson does well to get something on it. Fullish down leg and Powell will also feel he missed out
slow, short and put away! A loosener, which is sort of expected from a bowler called in from the cold. Ramandeep jumps up onto his toes and slaps it over extra cover!
into the blockhole on middle and off. Powell cannot get under it and plinks it off the toe-end to long on
low full toss on the pads. Powell clinks it off the toe-end towards the bowler
serious power! Back of a length outside off. Sits up and Powell has all the time in the world to bulldoze it over extra cover. One bounce and into the fence!
slow and short outside off. Ramandeep goes back and across before cutting it towards deep point
back of a length on middle and leg. Powell gets up on his toes and punches it towards deep mid wicket
hard length on middle and off. Powell gets up on his toes and stabs it towards deep mid wicket
off-cutter into the track outside off. Ramandeep lets the ball arrive before guiding it behind point
shortish outside off. Ramandeep rides the bounce and dabs it towards backward point
slower bumper on off. Cuts back in a touch and Ramandeep is happy to get under it. Called a wide
shot! On the shorter side again, just outside off. Ramandeep sits deep in his crease, picks up the length and mauls it over deep mid wicket!
smart batting! Slow, short, wide and too easy. Ramandeep throws his hands at it and flays it over backward point!
back of a length just outside off. Ramandeep shuffles across, trying to help it over short fine leg but is rushed on the stroke. Pinged on the thigh pad
full ball on the pads again. Powell glances it towards deep backward square leg. Decides to scramble back for the second and gets there, despite Samson flicking the throw onto the stumps Dhoni style
length ball, following the batter well outside leg. Ramandeep helps it towards short fine leg, albeit via his pad
fired in full on the pads. Powell comes forward and tucks it towards deep mid wicket
short outside off. Ramandeep hangs back and jabs it towards sweeper cover
googly on a length outside off. Powell reads it off the pitch and nudges it into the off side
googly dropped short outside off. Ramandeep hops back and cuts it towards deep point. He wanted the second too but his partner was not as interested
zipped in full on middle and off. Powell gets trapped on the crease and prods it with an open bat face towards backward point
shot of the night! This is a sumptuous hit. Full and wide. Powell gets his hands through the ball beautifully and creams it over cover!
dug in short again, just outside off. Ramandeep walks inside this slower bumper and pulls it down to fine leg
back of a length on off. Powell gets behind the line and pats it towards mid wicket
slower ball on a back of a length just outside off. Ramandeep goes back and across before helping it behind square

oh my, serious wheels first up. 140.9kph bumper, just outside off. Rears up and Ramandeep, swiping at it, is terribly late on the stroke. But hang on. Someone in the CSK camp has suggested that bat or glove may be involved, and we go upstairs. Nothing on UltraEdge, though. Flat line throughout, and Ramandeep survives!
back of a length outside off. Ramandeep goes deep into his crease and pushes it towards it sweeper cover

catching practice for long on, and Noor is weaving a web around the Knight Riders! Slowed up full just outside off and Rinku cannot resist the temptation to have a pop at it. The ball drops on him late, meaning he has to reach out. Loses all power on his shot and hits it straight down Dube's throat. CSK surge further into the ascendancy!
length just outside off. Rinku gets caught on the crease and pokes it into the off side
short and sliding into the hips. Rinku still cannot put it away. Heaves it straight to short fine leg
leg-spinner on a back of a length outside off. Rinku goes back and punches it towards cover
googly on a back of a length on the pads. Rinku glances it towards short fine leg
length ball on middle and off. Rinku gives himself room and jabs it towards deep point. Just a single, though
back of a length on middle and off. Powell hops back and stabs it towards long on
tossed up on a fullish length on middle and leg. Powell comes forward and defends
back of a length outside off. Rinku lets the ball arrive before chopping it towards deep backward point
fired in full on leg stump. Powell comes forward and eases it out towards deep mid wicket
shortish on the pads. Rinku waits on it before tugging it towards deep backward square leg

hot knife through butter, and KKR's million-dollar buy has been dispensed with for a golden duck! Seems like the leg-spinner, fizzing through on a back of a length outside off. Spins in with the angle and Green is all at sea. Tries to punch it too square on the off side and misses it, with the ball rattling into middle and leg. Green's woeful run continues; CSK tightening their grip now!

sliced again, and taken this time! Noor into the wickets too! Seems like another googly, dipping on a length on middle and off. Rahane looks to go inside-out but slices it horribly. Gaikwad runs back from extra cover and snares it. Noor with a dodgy celebration, where he puts his hands above his eyes, but CSK will not be complaining about that!
googly on a full length outside off. Rinku plants his front foot and drives it towards long on
googly on a full length on the pads. Rahane flicks it down the ground to long on
back of a length outside off. Rinku goes back and dabs it towards deep backward point
googly on a back of a length outside off. Punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover
fired in on a length on off. Rahane stretches forward and turns it into the mid wicket region
length ball on middle and leg. Rinku goes back and knocks it to long on
back of a length on the pads. Rinku helps it towards short fine leg

third time is the charm in the deep, and Akeal opens his IPL account! Darted in on a back of a length on middle and leg. Sticks and spins away, and that causes the slightly mistimed shot. Raghuvanshi gets a good chunk of it but nowhere near good enough to clear long on. Simple catch for Brevis, and CSK break this parntership!

goes straight up, and put down again! This is getting contagious now! Shortish on the stumps. Rahane miscues his pull completely and lobs it towards deep mid wicket. Sarfaraz hares in and grasses it. Hard hands again and the ball pops out!
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Raghuvanshi nudges it towards point and picks up another single
hard length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi drops it into the off side and keeps strike
four more! Gurjapneet leaking runs this over! Back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi gets on top of the bounce and steers it between backward point and short third!
off-pace on a back of a length on the pads. Rahane glances it towards short fine leg
two sixes in the over for Rahane! Fractionally short just outside off and Rahane climbs into it. He opens up his stance and wallops it over deep square leg!
slower ball into the track outside off. Rahane waits for it before dabbing it towards backward point
what a shot! Back of a length just outside off. Rahane walks across his stumps and laps it beautifully over short fine leg!
short and sliding down leg. Rahane looks to help it fine but is beaten for pace. Called a wide, though
pushed in on a length on off. Rahane comes forward and turns it towards deep backward square leg
arm-ball, on a back of a length on off. Raghuvanshi gives himself room and cuts it towards deep backward point
shortish on middle and leg. Raghuvanshi waits on it before tugging it to deep mid wicket's right. Back for another brace

palmed over the bar by Brevis - oh my! Shortish on middle and off, and this stands up a little. Raghuvanshi hops back and launches it towards long on. Brevis tears to his right, gets both hands to it but the hard hands mean the ball pops off the palm and lands beyond the rope!
slowed up on a full length outside off. Rahane plants his front foot and drags it towards deep mid wicket
arm-ball and this swerves into leg stump. On a back of a length and the batter, cramped for room, jabs it towards deep point
googly zipped in full on the pads. Rahane tucks it behind square and calls for two immediately. Has to scamper but makes it comfortably enough
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi relies on the conventional sweep this time and drags it towards deep mid wicket
just over! Back of a length just outside off. Raghuvanshi gets down on the reverse and lifts it over short third!
back of a length outside off. Rahane sits back and prods it into the off side
leg-spinner on a length on off. Raghuvanshi hangs back and chops it into the cover region
dragged down just outside off. Rahane hacks it rather tamely towards deep mid wicket
arm-ball, starting on a length on off and curving in. Raghuvanshi is tucked up completely and plays it back to the bowler
shortish on middle and leg. Not as much room to work with this time and Raghuvanshi jabs it straight to cover point
through the gap! Marginally short just outside off. Raghuvanshi rocks back, creates room and threads it between cover point and backward point!
big lbw shout, but the impact might be outside off! Back of a length just outside off. Skids through and Raghuvanshi, shaping for the sweep, misses it. Impact outside the line, replays confirm
back of a length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi gets deep into his crease and cuts it towards extra cover
shortish on middle and leg. Rahane hangs back and tugs it towards mid wicket
off-pace again, on a length outside off. Rahane presses forward and drives it towards deep backward point
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi gets up on his toes and dabs it towards deep backward point
safe! Back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi skips down the track and cloths it off the bottom of the bat towards mid off
on a length outside off. Raghuvanshi has a jab at it and squirts it off the outside edge towards short third

zipped through to short third, and Gurjapneet gobbles it up! Not sure how this got there, to be fair. Sizzling yorker just outside leg. Narine looks to work it through mid wicket and somehow gets it diametrically opposite to where he was aiming. Off the leading edge, and Khaleel is off on his celebratory run!
back of a length outside off. Rahane has a tug at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his body. Ball rolls away into the off side for a single
fullish just outside off. Narine gives himself room but clinks it right off the toe-end towards mid off
short on middle and leg. Narine keeps swinging and hacks it behind square for a couple of runs
Narine finally makes contact, and gets four! Shortish outside off. Narine gets his front hip out of the way and drags it past mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Narine has another pop at it but the bat again ends up in a different postcode to the ball

dropped - oh dear! Low full toss on the stumps. Narine cannot get under it fully and he plonks it off the toe-end. Straight to Gaikwad at mid off, and the skipper puts down a sitter. Tried to take it in front of his face and fluffed his lines!
short and nipping away outside off. Narine has an agricultural mow at it and misses the ball by an absolute mile
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Narine chalks it out towards extra cover and hares across to the other end
short and slanting across the batter outside off. Narine keeps swinging without a care in the world and misses this time
just beyond long on! Khaleel makes the same mistake as the first over. Dragged down on middle and leg, and Narine wallops it over the fence!
shortish and laced with width. Rahane throws his hands at it and slices it on the bounce to deep backward point
length outside off. Rahane gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards mid off
short outside off. Rahane shapes for the cut but cannot get any timing on it. Scuffed towards cover point
back of a length just outside off. Rahane drops it into the point region and scampers across to the other end
full and swinging away outside off. Rahane comes half forward and pokes it towards extra cover

a wild mow across the line, and Kamboj's wicket-taking streak continues! Fullish outside off and leaving the batter late. Allen loses his shape completely and whooshes at it. Goes straight up off the outer half of the bat and Dube, stood at point, makes no mistake!
in-swinging yorker, finishing on leg stump. Narine jams it out towards mid on and saunters across to the other end
more runs! Short and attempting to follow the batter outside leg. Narine has a swipe at it and gloves it past short fine leg!
full on off, and this shapes away a touch too. Allen comes forward and pushes it towards deep square leg
superb comeback. Very full and curving away late just outside off. Narine, without a stable base, wafts at it and misses
Narine is underway! Half-tracker on middle and leg, and this sits up. Narine opens up his stance and whacks it over the wide long on fence!
big out-swinger. Very full and shaping away outside off. Narine backs away before opting to let it go
banged in shorter just outside off. Narine backs away and swings like a rusty gate. Only connects with the fresh Chennai air
back of a length outside off. Narine goes chasing at it first up and misses the ball by a fair distance
back of a length on the pads. Allen a little rushed on the flick and the ball rolls off the thigh pad into the short fine leg region
